tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad = 2.44, within the specified gray zone, but does not sample the proposed supercritical range. The targeted high-gradient probe can resolve the consequential threshold ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the supercritical avalanche law to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot gradients lie below the stated critical range, so the threshold and avalanche strength are not identifiable.
The five correlated pilot inputs do not distinguish these smooth alternatives from a threshold mechanism.
The uncertainty concerns behavior above the critical gradient, not temporal resolution.
It is irrelevant to the competing mechanisms.
